finding.title: Mixed Typed/Native retained outputs can reject healthy short Native during fixed pressure hold
finding.impact: The original required progress gate fails despite no OOM, no Guard latch and eventual ownership recovery. Current exact head cannot be approved.
finding.observed: healthy typed Read full hash passes in276.884792ms; short Native returns NATIVE_NOT_STARTED/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED after1.000162667s during original3s hold.
finding.IO_stage_limit: No independent command-monitor trace or byte counter was captured for the health Native. Protocol evidence and exact error string are consistent with Runtime pre-dispatch memory denial; they do not independently establish backendbytes=0 or the exact locking branch. Mongo native GrowIO uses a different failure message.
finding.causal_hypothesis_not_proven: Native settle at execution_memory.go530-537 can mark a retained large reply as borrowed without executionBorrowWindow bound; the protected progress reserve only includes a small borrowed window. Subsequent resident outputs may leave less than one full negotiated Native IO window. Per-lease mutex-held denial evidence is required before calling this the precise cause.
finding.recommended_validation: Preserve this first failure. Derive a deterministic no-load ledger regression for mixed retained Typed and large Native outputs that asserts one healthy short Native dispatches within the unchanged budget and deadlines; then repeat original acceptance only on the corrected frozen source.
